falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,800 would violate the August 2024 bottom's key support level and invalidate the bottoming pattern comparison

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 39 typically accompanies elevated but controlled volatility; sustained VIX above 25 indicates panic selling rather than capitulation/bottom formation, contradicting the bottom signal

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further below -50 basis points (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion would signal worsening recession expectations rather than the soft-landing/recovery narrative implied by a bottoming pattern; this would break the macro conditions that supported the August 2024 bottom

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
